applies_why: The judge text addresses whether verses in the loins/seed row were answered or pressed, which is the kind of cited-verse counting the rule governs.
quote: [CR2] and [CR3] answered the loins/seed row with Genesis 46:26 and Hebrews 7:10
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge labels Genesis 46:26 and Hebrews 7:10 as answered and leaves the issue underdetermined, so it does not count those cited verses as unanswered witnesses.
